statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∀ (X : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ), 2 ≤ X → 0 ≤ A → (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2*X+2 → 0 ≤ f n ∧ f n ≤ A) → 0 ≤ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) - ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) - ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) ≤ 2*A^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0058 · 量化单端短窗与双端短窗的差二边界误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0058 · Bound the gap-two loss at the right edge of the window

brief.zh: 严格上界给出的最大整数是 (51X−1)/50。删掉 n+2 超窗的点最多两个。对 Λ 和真素数的对数权都能使用，供 TP-0013 与修正后的 TP-0053R 对照。
brief.en: The largest permitted integer is floor((51X−1)/50). At most two starting points lose their translated endpoint. The same estimate applies to Λ and prime log weights when comparing TP-0013 and TP-0053R.
